# Flow 10: the mistakes a Captain makes, and what Orbiter says.
#
# Commands that need an entity that does not exist fail with a message that names the problem,
# missing flags are reported as missing, and wrong argument counts are caught before anything runs.

step set up: a vessel with one galaxy
exec orbiter --output json vessel init -y
exec orbiter galaxy add test-corp

step a command that needs an entity that is not there says so
! exec orbiter survey nonexistent
stderr 'not found|no target'
! exec orbiter scan nonexistent
stderr 'not found|no target'
! exec orbiter jump nonexistent --yes
stderr 'not found|no target'

step a required flag that is missing is named
! exec orbiter planet add orphan-planet
stderr 'required flag.*galaxy|galaxy.*required'
! exec orbiter resource add myres --role tool
stderr 'required flag.*brand|brand.*required'
! exec orbiter resource add myres --brand git
stderr 'required flag.*role|role.*required'

step the wrong number of arguments is caught
! exec orbiter attach only-one
stderr 'accepts 2 arg'
